title: Hold out a fixed tenth of cells from the learned-context block
action: Follow the Contract for kom-1 in docs/history/knowledge-outcome-measure/plan.md. Kind cell dispatches get a deterministic arm: holdout when the first 8 hex digits of sha256_hex(cell id) as u32 mod 100 is below .bee/config.json knowledge_holdout_percent (absent or invalid = 10, integer 0..=100 honored, 0 = off). Holdout renders no Learned context block; knowledge arm prompt stays byte-identical. The kind cell prepare record gains knowledge_arm and learned_context (array of listed repo-relative paths, [] when none). Other kinds' records stay byte-identical. Write the tests first and watch them fail.

truths: A holdout cell brief carries no Learned context block
A knowledge-arm cell brief is byte-identical to before
The same cell id always lands in the same arm
knowledge_holdout_percent 0 holds out no cell; absent or invalid uses 10
The kind cell dispatch record carries knowledge_arm and learned_context; other kinds carry neither
